title: Breaker Fault SOP
body:
1. Inspect breaker B4 for a half-open position.
2. Reset the overload relay only after lockout-tagout is verified.
3. Verify fuse F7 before re-energizing the panel.

title: Neutral Lug Heat SOP
body:
1. Measure phase-to-neutral voltage at terminal block N2.
2. Tighten the neutral lug at N2 if movement is present.
3. Escalate immediately if discoloration or heat damage is visible.

title: Control Power Recovery SOP
body:
1. Verify control transformer secondary voltage.
2. Check control fuse F2 before restoring power.
3. Record downstream short findings before re-energizing the circuit.

title: Door Interlock SOP
body:
1. Inspect the enclosure door interlock plunger for a full return.
2. Reseat the interlock bracket if the latch is misaligned.
3. Escalate for visual review if the door cannot close flush.

title: Phase Loss Alarm SOP
body:
1. Measure line-to-line voltage across L1-L2 and L2-L3 at the incoming terminals.
2. Inspect the phase monitor relay LED and reset history before restarting the drive.
3. Escalate to a power-quality review if the phase-loss alarm returns after voltage verification.

title: Cooling Fan Failure SOP
body:
1. Inspect cabinet cooling fan rotation and airflow at the upper exhaust vent.
2. Replace the fan cartridge if rotation stalls or airflow is absent.
3. Escalate for visual review if the guard or fan wiring remains misaligned.

title: Breaker Indicator Cross-Reference
body: A red fault lamp near breaker B4 can also appear when control fuse F2 opens after a short stop. Confirm the panel section before replacing any fuse, and record whether the breaker handle is actually half-open.

title: Amber Alarm Reset Worksheet
body: If the amber phase monitor alarm is active, document enclosure temperature, cabinet fan noise, and prior reset attempts before calling support. This worksheet does not replace the cooling fan inspection SOP.
